test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: How much amount will be received on a principal of Rs. 10,000 at the rate of 12% per annum, compounded annually for 2 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal of Rs. 10,000

The rate of 12%

Time = 2 years

**Concept used:**

Amount = P(1 + R/100)T

P = Principal

R = Rate

T = Time

**Calculation:**

Amount = 10000(1 + 12/100)²

⇒ Amount = 10000(112/100)2

⇒ Amount = 10000(28/25)2

⇒ Amount = 12544

**∴ The amount will receive be Rs. 12544.**
